text: Nurse writes and saves a ward note once with mandatory fields: patient name, time, vitals, observations, and care tasks
Automatically send saved ward notes to both CarePath and WardFlow within 2 seconds under normal conditions
Show clear save status messages including 'Note saved successfully', 'Note saved and sending...', and retry options if sending fails
Retry sending notes every 5 minutes up to 20 times if CarePath or WardFlow is down, then alert supervisor via admin panel
Autosave nurse's draft note every 30 seconds in browser local storage and retry sending when network is restored
Role-based access control with nurses having full note entry, ward managers having read, comment, follow-up, and sign-off rights, and night nurses restricted to their own shift's notes
Ward managers can add comments or follow-up actions on nurse notes but cannot edit original nurse entries
Manager comments flagged as 'Review Requested' with visible labels and banners on nurse's note until resolved
Nurses can edit only their own notes in response to manager comments, with all edits logged in an audit trail
Audit trail records all note creations, edits, and comments with user identity and timestamps, retaining logs for at least 12 months
Automatically close review requests and notify managers when nurses save corrected notes
Use OAuth with IT-managed credentials for secure, revocable connections to CarePath and WardFlow
Web application accessible via any modern browser with no software installation required, supporting login via hospital’s existing identity provider
Handle personal and health data in compliance with GDPR and UK Data Protection Act, including encryption in transit and at rest
Data retention policy: no storage of patient data longer than 30 days unless part of official CarePath record; no caching beyond 5 minutes after sending
Clear all local drafts automatically on nurse logout or browser close to prevent data retention on devices
Support up to 18 concurrent nurse users during peak times without performance degradation
Admin panel shows active users, allows quick user addition, and displays alerts for failed note deliveries or system delays
Send reminders to nurses and managers if review requests are not addressed within two hours
Send end-of-shift reminders to ward managers for unreviewed notes, escalating to clinical lead if notes remain unreviewed two hours after shift end
